findings.issue: The base URL environment variable is double‑escaped. `replace(/"/g, "\\\"")` is applied before `JSON.stringify`, resulting in a value like `"\"https://example.com\""` which makes `window.__OMNIBRIDGE_BASE_URL__` contain stray quotes and breaks any code that consumes the URL.

API endpoints are registered as client‑side routes without a leading slash (e.g., `route("api/v1/chat/completions", ...)`). This makes them reachable as front‑end routes and bypasses any server‑side authentication/authorization, exposing potentially sensitive functionality.
The server entry imports the compiled build from `../build/server/index.js`. When the project is run in development mode (no build folder), this import throws at startup, causing the server to crash.
